summary: Frontend-only verification of light-mode readability fix in FullScreenNote.jsx. All 6 stated fix requirements are satisfied. Ran end-to-end Playwright checks in a fresh browser session: dismissed onboarding wizard, switched to icon (tile) view, created a note with a checklist, opened it in fullscreen in light mode, verified all computed styles/classes, then toggled to dark mode and re-verified. Tile grid regression check also passed.
critical_code_review_comments: FullScreenNote.jsx branches container background on isDark cleanly and preserves the accent border via colorConfig.border || colorConfig.accent — good fallback.

Consider unifying with NoteModal.jsx (pencil-edit modal) if it exhibits the same low-contrast issue in light mode — out of scope for this fix but worth a follow-up review (colorConfig gradient over bg-white with text-gray-700 body copy).

getNoteColorStyle returns null when colorConfig.gradient is falsy — for the test-created note (default color) the dark-mode container ended up with only border-width in inline style (no linear-gradient tint). Dark mode still renders the tinted look through the note-gradient class + colorConfig.class, so visually it matches pre-fix behavior. Not a regression, but noting since the review request implied dark-mode inline style would still contain 'linear-gradient'.

dark_mode_container.note: getNoteColorStyle returned null for default color config (no gradient prop); visual dark tint provided by note-gradient CSS class. Code path for dark mode is unchanged from pre-fix, so no regression.

seed_data_creation: Created one test note in-browser: title='Readability Test', body='Sample body text for contrast testing', checklist=['First check item']. Data lives in browser IndexedDB (offline PWA) — will not persist across fresh sessions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is a fully offline PWA. Each Playwright browser session starts with empty IndexedDB, so notes must be created within the same session. Onboarding wizard opens on first launch — dismiss by clicking 'Skip and never remind' then 'Skip' (2 clicks total). Toggle theme via header button with lucide-sun / lucide-moon svg icon (no data-testid on theme button — flag if adding one). Switch to tile grid via data-testid='view-mode-icon'. Tiles have data-testid='note-tile-<id>' (opens fullscreen) and data-testid='note-tile-edit-<id>' (opens NoteModal — the OTHER editor).
rca of the issue: N/A — verification pass. Fix works as described: FullScreenNote container's inline style in light mode contains only borderColor (no `background: tint` gradient), so bg-white is not overridden, and the darker text-gray-900 body/checklist copy plus indigo caret/selection classes yield high contrast against plain white. Dark-mode code path is untouched. Tile grid CSS (.note-tile-title) is untouched, tile appearance identical.
